full_page.content:
1933, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 86
Jan. Mrs. Herman Hanson - Lutheran - operated for cancer of liver - treated or observed by over 50 doctors .... .hopeless ..... is re- covering.
Mrs. Cath. Garrity Cotter - 44 - of Windsor - given up last Easter T.B. -.. . Her sister phoned to have her prayed for & enrolled .... now recovering .
Rose Ann Dubeau - 18 mo. - spinal maningitis
Desere Dezitter - 52 - serious operation expected. ... fears.
Helena DeWitte - nervous
Mrs. Hertha Hanson - 37 - lutheran - enrolled October 21 - thought to have cancer of liver; operated on Oct. 24 at time given up as hopeless - comes To-day quite convalesed - down to 80 1bs at time of operation now weighs 107.
Mrs. L. Hunteen -15 - Presbiterian, fearful ... St. Vitus Mrs. Ev. E. - baptist - about 50 - losing sight in one eye Jos. T. Cannon - 12 - Muskegan - cancer on knee ... wasting away Mrs. Ella Reaume - 69 - stomach-sist.
Jan. 20
Augustus LeGrand - 38 - convert from Hugonots ... fearful cancer of chest & throat. - 40 doctors - after 3 x-rays - give him up as hope- less - 4 specialists confirm said find's.
Mrs. Kingston - 52 - inward cancer ....
Mrs. Kathleen Schulte - 30 - 7338 Johanathan Rd. - enrolled Nov. 27th then "hopelessly dying" - blood poison - pertinitis etc. Comes to- day O.K.
Dan Boka - 28 - in Receiv. Hosp. Enrolled last night by phone, slept well - Better this a.m. Last night phone rang .. "Dan. Boka" in Rec. Hospital losing mind ... had been on strikes committee.
Page 87 Page 88 Jan.
Blank Page
James Tressler - 18 - barber itch
Mrs. Anna Bens - Glucoma .... Husband & 3
